title: CARE4BIO brokerage event: Horizon Europe Cluster 6 2027 calls
summary: A free brokerage event with short pitches of project ideas followed by pre-scheduled bilateral meetings.
details: Capacity is limited and registration is mandatory. Participant profiles are checked against quality criteria. It is open to companies including SMEs, universities, research organisations and other stakeholders from Europe and beyond.
why: The quality check on profiles makes preparation important. A concise pitch and a clear statement of what you offer a consortium will matter more than attendance alone.
